# PassICCExam.com

> > ICC certification exam preparation courses and study materials by Thompson Learning for contractors, inspectors, and trade professionals.

PassICCExam.com offers comprehensive online exam prep courses for ICC (International Code Council) certifications across electrical, plumbing, building, and energy conservation trades. The site provides study materials based on NEC, IRC, IBC, IPC, and IECC code books, along with navigation tools like Turbo Tabs and code skimming worksheets.

## Key Topics

- ICC Certification
- Thompson Learning
- National Electrical Code (NEC)
- International Residential Code (IRC)
- International Building Code (IBC)
- International Plumbing Code (IPC)
- Turbo Tabs
- Contractor Licensing
- Building Code Training
- Master Electrician
- Master Plumber
- Energy Conservation Inspector
- Commercial Combination Inspector
- Code Skimming Worksheets
- State-Specific Exams (South Dakota, Kansas, Wyoming)

## ICC Exam Preparation Courses

- [Pass ICC exam with our proven ICC certification exam preparation courses](https://passiccexam.com/exam/2021-79): ICC certification exam prep overview with free practice test
- [ICC T16 - Master Electrician Exam Study Course](https://passiccexam.com/product/icc-t16-master-electrician-exam-study-course): ICC T16 Master Electrician exam prep with NEC 2020 materials
- [Pass the ICC F24 National Standard Master Plumber Exam](https://passiccexam.com/product/pass-the-icc-f24-master-plumber-exam): ICC F24 Master Plumber exam prep with 2015 IPC study materials
- [ICC C5 Commercial Combination Exam Prep Course](https://passiccexam.com/product/icc-c5-inspector-exam-prep-course): ICC C5 Commercial Combination Inspector prep for B2, M2, P2, E2 exams
- [ICC 77 Energy Conservation Inspector Exam Prep Course](https://passiccexam.com/product/icc-77-energy-conservation-inspector-exam-prep-course): ICC 77 Energy Conservation Inspector exam prep with IECC materials
